name: Healing Potion
description: Restores 25 HP.

name: Rusty Dagger
description: A worn but serviceable dagger.

name: Iron Sword
description: A reliable iron sword.

name: Leather Armor
description: Light leather protection.

name: Chain Mail
description: Interlocked steel rings.

name: Steel Sword
description: Forged from tempered steel.

name: Plate Mail
description: Heavy steel plate armor.

name: Ring of Protection
description: +3 AC while worn.

name: Ring of Regeneration
description: Slowly regenerates HP over time.

name: Flame Sword
description: A blade wreathed in magical fire.

name: Greater Healing Potion
description: Restores 60 HP.

name: Holy Avenger
description: A blessed sword that burns the undead.

name: Ring of Protection +5
description: +5 AC while worn.

name: Rusty Sword
description: A corroded but still functional sword, salvaged from a shipwreck.

name: Silver Locket
description: A tarnished silver locket. The initials 'E.M.' are engraved on the back.

name: Antidote
description: Cures poison.

name: Rusty Key
description: A tarnished iron key. Opens simple wooden locks.

name: Iron Key
description: A heavy iron key. Opens reinforced iron gates.

name: Magic Crystal
description: A glowing arcane crystal. Dispels magical barriers.

name: Ring of Minor Protection
description: +1 AC while worn.

name: Moonbloom Herb
description: A silvery herb that blooms only at night. Healer Mira uses it to cure the sick.

name: Mooncrest Stone
description: A smooth stone that pulses with a cool blue light. Sought by Aldric the Alchemist.

name: Key of Tides
description: A crystalline key that pulses with the rhythm of the ocean. It opens the way to the next island.

name: Shard of Corruption
description: A fragment of the Corrupted Moon Guardian's power. Dark energy radiates from within. Something about it feels wrong — and strangely tempting.

name: Leather Cap
description: A simple leather cap.

name: Iron Helm
description: A sturdy iron helm.

name: Steel Helm
description: Forged from tempered steel.

name: Crown of Warding
description: A crown that deflects hostile magic.

name: Wooden Shield
description: A battered wooden shield.

name: Iron Shield
description: A solid iron shield.

name: Tower Shield
description: A massive shield offering great protection.

name: Aegis of Light
description: A radiant shield blessed by the gods.

name: Bone Amulet
description: A crude amulet carved from bone.

name: Amulet of Vitality
description: Pulses with restorative energy.

name: Amulet of Warding
description: Shields the wearer from hostile spells.

name: Amulet of the Arcane
description: An ancient amulet thrumming with arcane power.

name: Veil Shard
description: A translucent fragment that shimmers between dimensions. It feels warm to the touch.

name: Key of Embers
description: A blackened iron key glowing with inner heat. It opens the way to the Storm Archipelago.

name: Obsidian Blade
description: A razor-sharp blade forged from volcanic glass. Cuts through armor with ease.

name: Forged Steel Plate
description: Heavy plate armor forged in Pyralis's volcanic vents. Incredibly resilient.

name: Ember Shield
description: A shield rimmed with still-glowing embers. Warm to the touch.

name: Pyralis Fire Potion
description: A potion brewed with volcanic minerals. Restores 70 HP.

name: Shard of Ambition
description: A burning fragment that pulses with Pyralis's will. It radiates ambition and hunger.

name: Ember Heart
description: A pulsing core of living flame. It keeps something alive in the deep mines.

name: Blood-Stained Hammer
description: A forging hammer with dark stains on the head. Evidence of something terrible.

name: Key of Gales
description: A crystallized lightning bolt that hums with static. It opens the way to the Verdant Mangroves.

name: Stormcaller Blade
description: A sword that crackles with contained lightning. Strikes carry the fury of the storm.

name: Windweave Armor
description: Light armor woven from cloud-silk. Moves with the wind rather than against it.

name: Gale Shield
description: A shield of compressed air that deflects projectiles with gusts of wind.

name: Zephyr Helm
description: A helm adorned with wind-swept feathers. Grants clarity in storms.

name: Storm Amulet
description: A pendant shaped like a spiral cloud. Hums during thunderstorms.

name: Vial of Lightning
description: A glass vial filled with captured lightning. Restores 80 HP with a jolt.

name: Shard of Freedom
description: A fragment that shifts between solid and vapor. It whispers of absolute freedom — and the inability to ever stop.

name: Windchime Fragment
description: A broken piece of a sacred windchime. It still hums faintly in the breeze.

name: Sky Pirate's Compass
description: A compass that spins wildly near the hidden island. Captain Windlass swears it works.

name: Key of Roots
description: A living key of twisted wood that pulses with green energy. It opens the way to the Abyssal Depths.

name: Shard of Endless Growth
description: A fragment that writhes with living vines. It whispers of growth without end — beautiful, suffocating, eternal.

name: Verdant Blade
description: A sword forged from living wood that regrows its edge. Cuts carry the sting of thorn and sap.

name: Rootweave Armor
description: Armor woven from living roots that tighten against blows. Lightweight and resilient.

name: Amber Shield
description: A shield of crystallized amber that glows faintly. Absorbs impacts and reflects a fraction of spell energy.

name: Thornwood Staff
description: A staff of living thornwood. Each strike leaves barbs that continue to wound.

name: Sylvan Healing Draught
description: A potent draught brewed from rare forest herbs. Restores 90 HP.

name: Mycos Spore Pod
description: A pod of decomposition spores given by Fungal Lord Mycos. Plant at blight-hearts to restore the cycle.

name: Memory Crystal
description: A fragment of amber that holds a memory from before the Shattering. It glows warmly when touched.

name: Archive Crystal
description: A shard of black glass from the Archive of Tears. A name is still legible inside it, fading as you watch.

name: Key of Depths
description: A sphere of compressed abyssal water that never disperses. It opens the way to the next island.

name: Pressure Ward Fragment
description: A glowing shard of ward-stone that hums with protective energy. The Drowned Engineer needs these to repair the dome.

name: Seraphine's Journal (Vol. V)
description: A waterlogged journal found in the Pressure Temple. Seraphine writes of crushing truths and a god who watches from below.

name: Pressure Blade
description: A sword forged under immense deep-sea pressure. Its edge cuts with the weight of the ocean behind it.

name: Abyssal Plate
description: Armor crafted from pressure-hardened coral and abyssal metal. Resists both blows and arcane currents.

name: Coral Shield
description: A living coral shield that regenerates cracks over time. Its surface deflects spells with surprising ease.

name: Deep Trident
description: A three-pronged trident of dark iron, etched with deep-sea runes. Each strike echoes with the crushing deep.

name: Abyssal Healing Draught
description: A draught infused with bioluminescent plankton. Restores 100 HP.

name: Ancient Coral Relic
description: A calcified artifact from the ocean floor, encrusted with bioluminescent coral. It hums with residual dream-energy.

name: Leviathan Scale
description: A massive iridescent scale from an ancient leviathan. It feels warm despite the crushing cold of the deep.

name: Key of Echoes
description: A crystallized memory that resonates with forgotten voices. It opens the way to the final island.

name: Archive Key
description: A translucent crystal key that hums with preserved memory. Grants passage into the Memory Archive.

name: Memory Crystal (First Civilization)
description: A restored crystal preserving the founding of the first mortal civilization under Aqualon's protection.

name: Memory Crystal (The Betrayal)
description: A restored crystal preserving the moment the Seven Dreams first considered betrayal.

name: Memory Crystal (Seraphine's Visit)
description: A restored crystal preserving Seraphine's arrival at Echo Point thirty years ago.

name: Memory Crystal (The Vision)
description: A restored crystal preserving a vision of the world reunited, as it could be if the Shards were joined.

name: Eighth Dream Evidence
description: Proof that an eighth dream once existed — Hope — consumed by the other seven to prevent warning Aqualon.

name: Shadow Blade
description: A sword forged from crystallized shadow. Its edge cuts between memory and flesh.

name: Memory Mail
description: Armor woven from preserved memories. Each link holds a forgotten name.

name: Echo Shield
description: A shield that repeats the last blow it absorbed, deflecting it back into the void.

name: Ring of Remembrance
description: A silver ring warm with retained memory. Remembered wards turn aside blows.

name: Shadow Tonic
description: Distilled from memory-rich water. Heals 115 HP.

name: Seraphine's Journal (Vol. VI)
description: A journal found in the Archive of Tears. Seraphine writes of an eighth dream that was consumed, and keys that are dreams crystallized.

name: Key of Iron
description: A heavy, unadorned iron key bearing the scratches and dents of countless battles. It opens the way to the Cradle of Shards.

name: Shard of Corruption (Bellorak)
description: A shard of invincibility torn from Seraphine. It whispers of victory without risk, glory without danger.

name: Iron Warsword
description: A brutal longsword forged for the Golden War. Its edge has been honed by generations of arena champions.

name: Battle Plate
description: Heavy iron plate scarred by decades of war. Each dent is a story of survival.

name: Champion's Shield
description: A battered shield bearing the sigil of Bellorak's arena. It has blocked a thousand killing blows.

name: War Tonic
description: A thick, iron-tasting draught brewed for soldiers. Heals 130 HP.

name: Seraphine's Journal (Vol. VII)
description: The final journal. Seraphine writes: 'I entered the arena thinking I could win. I was wrong. The keys carry the dreams. End it. Please.'

name: Scroll of Magic Missile
description: Teaches the Magic Missile spell.

name: Scroll of Sleep
description: Teaches the Sleep spell.

name: Scroll of Cure Light Wounds
description: Teaches the Cure Light Wounds spell.

name: Scroll of Protection from Evil
description: Teaches the Protection from Evil spell.

name: Scroll of Shield
description: Teaches the Shield spell.

name: Scroll of Charm Monster
description: Teaches the Charm Monster spell.

name: Scroll of Fireball
description: Teaches the Fireball spell.

name: Scroll of Lightning Bolt
description: Teaches the Lightning Bolt spell.

name: Scroll of Cure Serious Wounds
description: Teaches the Cure Serious Wounds spell.

name: Scroll of Bless
description: Teaches the Bless spell.

name: Scroll of Invisibility
description: Teaches the Invisibility spell.

name: Scroll of Turn Undead
description: Teaches the Turn Undead spell.

name: Scroll of Ice Storm
description: Teaches the Ice Storm spell.

name: Scroll of Dispel Magic
description: Teaches the Dispel Magic spell.

name: Scroll of Cure Critical Wounds
description: Teaches the Cure Critical Wounds spell.

name: Scroll of Prayer
description: Teaches the Prayer spell.

name: Scroll of Holy Word
description: Teaches the Holy Word spell.

name: Scroll of Teleport
description: Teaches the Teleport spell.

name: Scroll of Cone of Cold
description: Teaches the Cone of Cold spell.

name: Scroll of Cloudkill
description: Teaches the Cloudkill spell.

name: Scroll of Haste
description: Teaches the Haste spell.

name: Scroll of Heal
description: Teaches the Heal spell.

name: Scroll of Restoration
description: Teaches the Restoration spell.

name: Scroll of Resist Elements
description: Teaches the Resist Elements spell.

name: Scroll of Chain Lightning
description: Teaches the Chain Lightning spell.

name: Scroll of Death Spell
description: Teaches the Death Spell.

name: Scroll of Holy Armor
description: Teaches the Holy Armor spell.

name: Scroll of Flame Strike
description: Teaches the Flame Strike spell.

name: Scroll of Scrying
description: Teaches the Scry spell, which lays a dungeon level bare to the mind’s eye.

name: Scroll of Meteor Swarm
description: Teaches the devastating Meteor Swarm spell.

name: Scroll of Power Word Kill
description: Teaches the Power Word Kill spell.

name: Scroll of Resurrection
description: Charges a resurrection ward, reviving you upon death.

name: Scroll of Sanctuary
description: Teaches the Sanctuary spell.

name: Scroll of Wishing
description: Teaches the Wish spell. The parchment is blank until you need it to say something.

name: Scroll of Time Stop
description: Teaches the Time Stop spell. Reading it takes no time at all.

name: Scroll of Divine Intervention
description: Teaches Divine Intervention — a prayer answered by whichever god is listening.

name: Hard Bread
description: Stale, and it keeps forever. Restores 60 food.

name: Dried Fish
description: Salted on the quayside. Restores 110 food.

name: Travel Rations
description: A week of walking in one bundle. Restores 220 food.

name: Honeyed Loaf
description: Rich enough to walk an island on. Restores 400 food.

name: Lumen Coral
description: A finger of coral holding a light it was given a hundred years ago. Nobody has ever asked it to give the light back, and it has never worked out that it could refuse.

name: Seraphine's Press
description: Trench-glass holding the impression of a woman walking on the sea floor. Salt-burned, surface build, armed like someone who expected the trip. A scar on the sternum that opens like a mouth. The pressure kept her shape. Something else kept the rest of her.

name: Ordinary Day
description: A memory of nothing whatever. Rain on a roof, a queue, bread going stale. It weighs almost nothing, which is the entire point Keeper Mord is trying to make and which Umbryn has never once conceded.

name: Seraphine's File
description: Forty years of one woman, in Umbryn’s own hand. Arrival. Seven islands. Seven keys. The Cradle. And then a final entry that is not a death notice but an enlistment — and a note, in different ink, that the file was moved out of the Archive because people kept reading it.

name: Corran's Letter
description: Written by a Gold Guard captain to be opened if he fell, addressed to a woman who was in neither army. Sealed thirty-one years. The hand is steady until the last line, and the last line is: you were right, and I stayed anyway, and I would like you to know that I knew.
